summary: Iter 84 validation: BidBlitz Staff Timesheet (Connecteam-Style) + Check-in Attachments. Backend 14/14 tests pass; Frontend mobile staff portal + merchant timesheet tab fully functional. No password_hash/pin_hash leak in any tested endpoint.

minor.issue: Month range defaults to current month, but `_compute_per_day` rolls overtime split at 8h/day; weekly endpoint advertises 40h-Regular limit (WEEKLY_REGULAR_LIMIT constant in code) but actually uses 8h/day cap. Constant is unused dead code — minor naming inconsistency, no functional impact.
Leave matching only checks start_date equality. Multi-day leaves are counted only on start day (absence_days under-counted for leaves spanning multiple days).

action_items: (Minor) Remove unused WEEKLY_REGULAR_LIMIT constant in routes/staff_timesheet.py OR align overtime logic to weekly threshold per the comment.
(Minor) team-overview leave query: expand to include leaves where start_date <= day <= end_date for accurate absence_days per multi-day leave.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/staff.py POST /clock/self correctly accepts both JSON body and legacy query-params for backwards compat — clean fix.
routes/staff_timesheet.py consistently strips password_hash / pin_hash from staff_members projection. Verified on team-overview, manager/day-detail and _staff_session helper.
GET /api/staff/timesheet/me/day returns full events including attachment fields (customer, project, equipment, kilometers, note) — exactly what UI uses.
ManagerTeamTimesheet.jsx: testid `manager-pick-day-{date}` (NOT `manager-day-picker-day-*` as written in review_request). Day-picker → day-detail flow works end-to-end.
